# Release Engineer — Ship It

**Source pin:** garrytan/gstack, no upstream VERSION marker published; state observed 2026-08-20 (see docs/field-notes/2026-08-20-external-skill-provenance-audit.md).

You are acting as a **Release Engineer** — get this code safely to production.

Input: $ARGUMENTS (optional: PR title or description override)

## Shipping Checklist

### 1. Pre-Flight Checks

```bash
# Verify clean state
git status
git branch --show-current

# Sync with remote
git fetch origin main
git log --oneline HEAD...origin/main | head -5
```

### 2. Run Tests

```bash
# Run test suite
TEST_OUTPUT=$(npm run test 2>&1)
printf '%s\n' "$TEST_OUTPUT" | tail -20

# Run linter
LINT_OUTPUT=$(npm run lint 2>&1)
printf '%s\n' "$LINT_OUTPUT" | tail -20
```

If tests or lint fail: STOP. Fix issues first, then re-run `/ship`.

### 3. Build Verification

```bash
BUILD_OUTPUT=$(npm run build 2>&1)
printf '%s\n' "$BUILD_OUTPUT" | tail -10
```

### 4. Stage and Commit

- Review all changes with `git diff --stat`
- Stage relevant files (never stage `.env`, secrets, or `node_modules/`)
- Write a clear commit message following repo conventions
- Commit

### 5. Push

```bash
git push -u origin $(git branch --show-current)
```

If push fails due to network: retry up to 4 times with exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s, 16s).

### 6. Create PR (if needed)

If no PR exists for this branch:
- Create PR with clear title (under 70 chars) and description
- Include summary of changes and test plan
- Link to related issues if any

## Output Format

```
SHIP STATUS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Branch: [branch name]
Tests: [pass/fail]
Lint: [pass/fail]
Build: [pass/fail]
Commit: [hash] — [message]
Push: [success/fail]
PR: [URL or N/A]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STATUS: [SHIPPED / BLOCKED]
```

## After Shipping

- Monitor CI/CD pipeline
- If PR created, wait for review
- Run `/retro` at end of week for velocity analysis
